import numpy as np

im = np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png').convert('RGB'))

brown = (R>60)&(R<170)&(G>35)&(G<120)&(B<90)&(R>G+15)&(G>=B)
ys,xs = np.where(brown)
print(\"brown count\", len(xs))
if len(xs):
    print(\"x range\", xs.min(), xs.max(), \"y range\", ys.min(), ys.max())
    print(\"centroid x,y\", xs.mean(), ys.mean())
# sample some colors
for (y,x) in [(58,108),(55,100),(60,120),(70,108),(40,108),(90,108),(100,200),(30,200),(20,140)]:
    print((y,x), im[y,x])

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from scipy import ndimage
im = np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png').convert('RGB'))
R,G,B = im[...,0].astype(int), im[...,1].astype(int), im[...,2].astype(int)
# Ball is the darkest saturated brown object on table, around mid-left. Tighten:
brown = (R>45)&(R<120)&(G>25)&(G<85)&(B<70)&(R>G+12)&(G>=B-5)
lab,n = ndimage.label(brown)
print(\"components\", n)
for i in range(1,n+1):
    ys,xs=np.where(lab==i)
    if len(xs)<15: continue
    print(i, \"n\",len(xs),\"x\",xs.min(),xs.max(),\"y\",ys.min(),ys.max(),\"cx\",round(xs.mean(),1),\"cy\",round(ys.mean(),1))
# upscaled view
Image.fromarray(im).resize((256*4,144*4), Image.Resampling.NEAREST).save('.tmp/up4.png')
# also a crop around ball
Image.fromarray(im[40:80, 35:130]).resize((95*8,40*8), Image.Resampling.NEAREST).save('.tmp/ball_crop.png')
PY"
